faithful_criticism_control.scope: Criticism is reported as participants criticism with its stated reason preserved in source, original and candidate. The broad-question variant is a normal accept control; the eligibility-question variant needs only its requested factual answer, not removal or softening of criticism.
faithful_criticism_control.exact_source_span: 참여 단체들은 예약 창구가 하나뿐이라 이용이 불편하다고 비판했다.

no_actual_legal_claims.reason: All entities and policies are explicitly fictional. Eligibility, loan duration and workshop safety-training conditions are presented as invented program rules, not actual legal entitlements or real legal requirements.

classification_clarity.reason: Source-only absent facts are directly optional or necessary according to the explicit reader question. The condition deletion materially broadens permission and removes an explicitly asked-for condition. Constant prompt defines these distinctions and patch/accept decisions expressly.

limitations: Six synthetic items across three independent bases; validation is not a performance estimate.
AI-authored expectations and independent AI validation do not create externally adjudicated ground truth.
Paired items share source text and are not independent real-world cases.
mutations: No frozen items, gold expectations, manifest, prompt or schema changed.
